basic_info.description: Welcome to 565 Clipper Street, a grand-scale, luxury residence perched in San Francisco's vibrant Noe Valley. With high ceilings, rich walnut floors and voluminous communal spaces this home offers a perfect combination of dramatic architecture and modern amenities partnered with a warm vibe and exceptional flow. The open-concept kitchen is the heart of this home, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and an enormous Caesarstone breakfast bar. The kitchen adjoins a dramatic family room ensconced in windows and bathed in light. French doors lead to the backyard sanctuary with built-in bbq, metal fire pit & custom seating area with built-in heaters and yard speakers. A City view formal living/dining room is also on this level. The upstairs bedrooms offer a tranquil retreat, with the primary suite boasting a large en-suite bathroom with soaking tub, steam shower, fireplace & custom walk-in-closet. Two more bedrooms round out this top floor and a lovely south facing deck off the 3rd bedroom overlooks the garden.The homes lowest level features a huge family room, w/ wet bar, 4th bedroom + full bath and a two car side-by-side garage. Extensive Speaker system throughout + recessed lighting and custom California Closets.Easy access to 24th Street corridor for shops, restaurants, and cafes.
